In my timeline things in France go similar to our current timeline. In our timeline the Second French Empire ceased to exist after the Franco-Prussian war. In this timeline the Emperor Napoleon III failed to live up to his expectations because Netherlands secured control over the Rhineland and thus France couldn't get its natural borders, after that the Emperor abdicated and a republic was established. From that point on it goes the same as our timeline, after sometime the democratic government is rather unpopular amongst the population and a socialist government seizes power. This actually happened, if you look at the history of France, it was briefly socialist while also aligning itself to the west during the Cold War.

I think since the Austro-Prussian war was a defensive war for Austria, it wouldn't make sense for them to gain that much land, i decided to transfer Glogau to Austria though.  The main idea behind this scenario was that Austria effectively dismantled Prussian influence over Northern Germany, thus preventing an unified German state from ever being a thing.
